**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer)

- **No LD concept exists in the document.** Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee" and acceleration language all returned nothing.
- **Article 12 imposes no exit cost on us.** Section 12.3 lets AbbVie terminate in whole or by country "for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice" with no minimum or early-termination fee. Section 12.10.1 preserves only amounts accrued before termination (milestones/Net Sales events already occurring) — earned consideration, not a liquidated sum.
- **Section 6.10 late-payment interest is mutual** ("If any payment due to either Party ... is not paid when due") and compensatory, so it is not a Customer-side penalty.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline was proposed.
